ghi_chu.mo_ta: A tall, thin, isolated column or obelisk stands on the skyline at the right of centre. It looks like the Monument to the Great Fire.
ghi_chu.ly_do: The Monument was built in 1671–77, after 1666. The city is still smouldering ruins in this frame.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: Old St Paul's should appear as a ruined Gothic tower without a dome. No such large central tower is recognisable on the skyline. There are only three identical square, chimney-like towers on a wall at far left, plus small distant spires.
ghi_chu.ly_do: The landmark expected in this view is missing or replaced by generic towers and walls.
